items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: Rashied and Henry were interviewed in Clinton, New York on 1/30/09 before a duo concert at Hamilton, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

ctx.x: Rashied and Henry were interviewed in Clinton, New York on 1/30/09 before a duo concert at Hamilton, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming at Hamilton College for the Jazz Archive, and I’m really pleased to have Henry Grimes and Rashied Ali with me today, two of the most forward thinking people I’ve come to know, I think it’s safe to say. Do you think of yourself as a forward thinking person?
